title: (web) Score view: Download for your DAW button, progress, errors, skip-loudness option
description: Need, not visuals: an action on the Score view (web/src/ui/score.ts) that runs the browser export, shows render and fetch progress, offers a skip-loudness option, surfaces located errors the way the editor already does, and triggers the download. Works signed out on the public site. The web session designs it.
